mapper.select: SELECT full_symbol AS fullSymbol, name AS name, fullname AS fullname, market AS market, publisher AS publisher, index_type AS indexType, category AS category, base_date AS baseDate, base_point AS basePoint, list_date AS listDate, weight_rule AS weightRule, description AS description, exp_date AS expDate FROM index_basic_data WHERE 1 = 1
mapper.sql: SELECT full_symbol AS targetCode, name AS targetName, 'STOCK' AS targetType, exchange AS marketCode, 0 AS sortNo, FALSE AS importantFlag, 3 AS watchStatus, NULL AS watchReason FROM type_basic_data.stock_basic_data
mapper.select: WHERE list_status = 'L' AND symbol LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN symbol = #{keyword} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, symbol ASC LIMIT #{limit}
